response.overview: Noah Feliz, A big time gangster, is offered a chance to make some big money when a narcotics/gangster Brian Thompson pays him a visit. But things go wrong very quickly. Watch how the story unfolds in this gangster epic. With acts of violence, betrayal, and fights for power. No one is safe.
